production_execution.resume_policy: regenerate the frozen per-size activity and orientation-uniform streams, verify every stored record hash, then continue at the next complete record
production_execution.arm_time_claim_boundary: Preflight passage arms only the five registered cells; production output remains non-evidence until integrity, precision/censoring and complete-matrix analysis pass.

production_outcome.decision: finite-size outward gap motion across q=.90,.94,.97; no low-gap-tail takeover through L11; thermodynamic class unresolved

authorization: Researcher requested boundary-focused data quality rather than uniform phase-map resampling and then authorized the larger decoder-independent transition question.
question: At p=0.30, does the q=0.90--0.97 boundary window show persistent low-gap mass, outward-moving typical gaps, or a low-gap rare tail that dominates the remaining Bayes risk?
claim_boundary: This is a focused finite-size discrimination study. It may identify which posterior-gap mechanism warrants larger-scale study; it cannot estimate a threshold, critical q, exponent or universality class.

physical_contract.observation: full physical charge record Q only
physical_contract.score: ground-truth binary logical sector with exact Bayes risk
physical_contract.independent_unit: one independently generated physical current and its charge record

matrix.precision_stop: after a full batch, stop a cell only when both the Wilson 95% half-width for C_L(1) is at most 0.04 and the record-bootstrap 95% half-width for Bayes risk is at most 0.025

matched_sampling.within_size_q_coupling: use the same activity and orientation-uniform streams across q for newly generated cells at a common L
matched_sampling.across_size_relation: independent streams; never pair L contrasts
matched_sampling.old_new_relation: retain old cells as independent historical controls and do not label them paired with new q=0.94 or L=11 rows
matched_sampling.intervals: pointwise 95%; every finite-size mechanism decision must report all registered observables and cannot rely on one selected interval

secondary: median and lower quartile of abs(DeltaF)
integrity: record counts and stream keys are unique
exact posterior normalization and sector-swap invariance pass

preflight_gate.operation: construct and replay the exact L=11 q=0.94 oracle on deterministic synthetic and limiting records without generating production histories
preflight_gate.failure_action: censor the L=11 branch and stop; do not substitute an approximate posterior or broaden the matrix

acceptance_criteria: The L=11 exact-oracle preflight passes every identity and resource cap before production is armed.
Every new cell reaches the registered minimum and either both precision targets or the hard maximum, with censoring reported rather than hidden.
The analysis reports R_L, C_L(a), gap quantiles and B_L(a) together, so a growing median cannot masquerade as vanishing risk.
The three competing finite-size mechanisms are assessed on the complete matrix; no threshold, crossing fit or BKT claim is made.
stop_rule: Run the preflight first. If it passes, acquire only the five registered cells in batches and stop each cell at its precision rule or hard cap. Do not add p values, q values, sizes, approximations or decoder comparisons in this contract.
